title: Suggest marketing sources and setup improvements
description: Scan the project's marketing analytics setup and return ranked recommendations. Use when the user asks which data sources or ad platforms to connect, or what to fix next. Suggestions with kind connect_source identify missing integrations inferred from observed traffic, with evidence, confidence, event volume, and a optional deep_link to the connection flow. Present these as recommendations, not proof that the user owns an account on that platform. Other suggestions cover existing integration health, UTM mappings, and conversion goals. This tool only reads data; it does not connect a platform or apply changes. Direct the user to the returned connection link, when provided, to complete authorization. Use refresh=true for an explicit rescan. If degraded is non-empty, explain that some checks failed. If truncated is true, describe totals as approximate. Requires a project with the Marketing analytics setup plan enabled.

methodDocumentation.text: Rank everything wrong with a team's marketing analytics setup into concrete suggestions, each carrying the evidence behind it and — where one exists — an `apply` operation to pass straight to apply_setup_ops, plus a `readiness` block saying which capabilities (cost, ROAS, cost per customer, retention by channel) are unlocked and which suggestion is blocking each. Prefer this over `diagnose` when the question is 'what should I fix next': diagnose explains what is wrong, setup_plan says what to do about it in a form you can act on. Read-only.
